skill.name: seo-geo
skill.description: Audit websites for traditional SEO and generative engine optimization. The skill checks metadata, schema, robots.txt, sitemaps, AI crawler access, keywords, and DataForSEO workflows.
skill.summary: Audit websites for SEO, AI search visibility, schema markup, and keyword opportunities.
skill.author: resciencelab

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown examples, schema placeholders, and words like keyword. Confirmed issues are limited to intended network and API access, environment credential reads, unrestricted URL fetching, and one dangerous curl-to-shell example in documentation. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: Pipe-to-shell installation advice in schema template
remediation.suggestion: Remove the curl pipe to bash example from references/schema-templates.md line 53. Use safe, inspectable installation wording instead.
Validate schemes and hostnames, block private IP ranges, and ask for confirmation before fetching non-public targets.

remediation.issue: External API credentials handled by helper scripts
remediation.suggestion: Document that DataForSEO credentials are sent only to api.dataforseo.com, and avoid printing secrets or full request URLs.
Label curl, python, and browser commands as optional external requests that require user confirmation before execution.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted URL Fetching Enables Internal Network Probing
semantic_findings.description: The SEO audit script accepts a URL argument, prepends https when no scheme exists, and fetches the page, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml without host restrictions. A malicious or mistaken target could make the agent contact internal or sensitive network addresses.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly fetches user-controlled URLs and derived paths with urllib and no allowlist or private network guard. The behavior is useful for SEO, but it creates a clear SSRF-style risk in agent environments.

content.user_title: Optimize Websites for SEO and AI Search
content.value_statement: Teams need search content that works for Google and AI answer engines. This skill audits pages, guides keyword research, and creates schema recommendations for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Audits title tags, descriptions, H1 text, JSON-LD count, robots.txt, sitemap status, and load time.
Provides schema templates for FAQPage, Article, WebPage, Product, Organization, HowTo, Breadcrumb, LocalBusiness, and Speakable.
Guides keyword research, SERP analysis, related keywords, autocomplete ideas, backlinks, domain overview, and competitor gap workflows.
Reviews AI crawler access for GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, and Bingbot.
Produces SEO and GEO reports with current status, recommendations, and validation steps.
limitations: DataForSEO workflows require user-provided DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD environment variables.
Script outputs are command-line summaries, not a full crawler or dashboard.
Example commands access external websites and APIs when run.
Research claims and search metrics should be verified before publication.

use_cases.title: Audit a Product Website
use_cases.description: Check metadata, schema, robots.txt, sitemap, performance, and AI crawler access before launch.

use_cases.title: Plan Search Content
use_cases.description: Find keyword ideas, SERP patterns, and AI answer opportunities for a content roadmap.

use_cases.title: Improve Structured Data
use_cases.description: Select schema templates and validation steps for pages that need rich results or AI citations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Homepage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-geo workflow to audit {url}. Summarize P0 issues, metadata gaps, schema status, robots.txt, sitemap, and AI crawler access.

prompt_templates.title: Create a GEO Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a GEO plan for {topic} and {audience}. Include answer-first sections, citation targets, statistics to verify, FAQs, and schema recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Structured Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page summary: {page_summary}. Recommend the best schema types, required fields, validation steps, and content changes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Competitive Keyword Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare {my_domain} with {competitor_domain}. Identify keyword gaps, SERP patterns, intent clusters, and actions that improve Google and AI search visibility.

output_examples.input: Audit a SaaS homepage for SEO and GEO readiness.
output: Title exists but should include the primary product category earlier.
Description is missing a clear value proposition and target keyword.
FAQPage schema is a strong next step because the page answers buyer questions.
robots.txt should mention major AI crawlers before launch.

output_examples.input: Plan content for an AI developer tool.
output: Primary cluster: AI developer tools for coding teams.
Support pages should cover setup, pricing, alternatives, security, and use cases.
Use answer-first summaries and cite benchmark sources after verification.
Add Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, and Breadcrumb schema where appropriate.

output_examples.input: Review AI crawler access for a documentation site.
output: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, and Bingbot should be checked in robots.txt.
The sitemap should include important documentation sections and recent update dates.
Blocked pages should be reviewed against the desired AI citation strategy.

best_practices: Ask for the target URL, primary audience, market, and priority pages before running checks.
Verify tool output with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and schema validators.
Treat generated schema and claims as drafts until reviewed against real page content.
anti_patterns: Do not run API scripts before the user provides credentials and confirms external requests.
Do not publish placeholder domains, fake statistics, or template claims as final content.
Do not optimize by keyword stuffing or by blocking legitimate crawlers.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes websites for traditional search engines and AI answer engines through audits, schema guidance, and content planning.

faq.question: Does it require paid APIs?
faq.answer: The basic SEO audit does not require an API. Keyword and competitive research scripts require DataForSEO credentials.

faq.question: Can it generate schema markup?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides schema templates and recommends suitable schema types for common page categories.

faq.question: Does it make network requests?
faq.answer: Yes, when scripts or command examples are run. These requests target user-provided URLs or documented SEO APIs.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for audits and optimization planning.

faq.question: Should results be reviewed before publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Validate metrics, citations, schema, and claims against the live website and trusted search tools.
